protocol.feature_representation: Frozen final DINOv2 CLS token concatenated with mean patch tokens
protocol.preprocessing: Same exact EXIF/white-alpha/pixel-center-nearest224/ImageNet transform and feature cache as photo_model_common.py

categories.label: Eczema / contact dermatitis-like category
scin: Allergic contact dermatitis caused by allergenic hapten derived from plant
Contact dermatitis caused by Rhus diversiloba

protocol.taxonomy_status: Predeclared research grouping; not clinically reviewed or a validated disease taxonomy
taxonomy_notes: All unlisted labels belong to other. No substring-based reassignment.
Lentigo maligna is grouped with melanoma including in-situ disease, not with benign pigmentation.
Nevus category excludes atypical nevus, epidermal nevus and nevus sebaceous. Its output never establishes benignity.
Urticaria excludes urticarial vasculitis and pregnancy-specific eruptions.
Dermatitis excludes seborrheic, perioral, infected, vascular, phototoxic and bullous conditions.
Fitzpatrick source terms acne/acne vulgaris contain heterogeneous acneiform presentations; no severity claim.

label_rule.Fitzpatrick17k-C: Exact source label mapping, otherwise other
label_rule.SCIN: Sum source differential weights within each category including residual other; retain unique maximum >=0.50; exclude ties, nonfinite/negative weights or total not approximately1
label_rule.duplicate_conflicts: Remove entire finer-category-conflicting duplicate group, retaining all remaining original split memberships

training.head: Train-only weighted StandardScaler + multinomial logistic regression; scaler folded into exported linear weights
training.training_views: All cached train views, equal aggregate weight per case and category
training.evaluation_views: First available image per case; never best-view selection
training.selection: Maximum pooled validation macro-F1 across all14 categories, then balanced accuracy across represented categories, then candidate order (small backbone and lowerC first)
training.calibration: Validation-only NLL temperature grid0.50 through4.00 step0.05

protocol.source_evaluation: Always report each source separately; a class without30 test groups in a source has no supported source-specific claim
protocol.test_policy: Both backbones fitted and validation-selected head locked before any related shared final test is opened; final evaluation accepts only the locked model, cohort, features and protocol
limitations: SCIN source labels are retrospective differentials; atlas labels are not uniformly pathology-confirmed.
No patient IDs: image/case duplicate grouping does not prove patient independence.
DINOv2 pretraining overlap is unknown; heldout refers to SkinSnap downstream fitting only.
Research/noncommercial image terms; no commercial deployment clearance.
Finite14-group task cannot identify arbitrary diseases, severity or normal skin, nor establish product efficacy.
This task inherits the eligibility and exclusions of the original3-class combined cohort and is not a new representative sample.
